Excellent! All 56 tests pass. I've created the render module with proper text formatting:

**`src/render.js`** with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`:
- First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued)
- Second line: customer name (looked up from customerId)
- One line per invoice item: `{qty} x {name} @ {formatted unit price} = {formatted line total}`
- Last line: `Total: {formatted total}`
- All amounts use `formatEuros()` for proper euro formatting with thousands separators

**Example output:**
```
INV-2026-0001
Kite & Co
2 x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €170.00
5 x Icon set (24 icons) @ €9.80 = €49.00
Total: €219.00
```

**Tests** covering:
- Draft and issued invoices
- Multiple lines with proper formatting
- Large amounts with thousands separators
- Unknown customer fallback ("Unknown Customer")
- Invoice numbering displays correctly
